# nimData

## Temporalité 

### changement d'états
```{r}
# création de trucs vides pour stocker nos variables
gamma <- numeric(simul.nimConstants$n.years1)
w <- numeric(simul.nimConstants$n.years1)
h <- numeric(simul.nimConstants$n.years1)
phi <- numeric(simul.nimConstants$n.years1) # 6 zéros pour stocker les réalisations
omega <- array(0, 
               dim = c(4, 4, simul.nimConstants$n.years1)) # 4 états possibles

# mise a jour / calculation de nos probas
for (t in 1:simul.nimConstants$n.years1) {
  # calcule des probas de transitions
  gamma[t] <- runif(1, 0, 1)
  w[t] <- runif(1, 0, 0.59)
  h[t] <- runif(1, 0, 0.39)
  phi[t] <- 1 - h[t] - w[t]
  
  # calcul des probas de chaque état
  omega[1, , t] <- c(1 - gamma[t], gamma[t], 0, 0)
  omega[2, , t] <- c(0, phi[t], h[t], w[t])
  omega[3, , t] <- c(0, 0, 0, 1)
  omega[4, , t] <- c(0, 0, 0, 1)
}
```

### z matrice etats pour individus
Matrice de l'état de nos individus a chaque étape
```{r}
# State matrix (individual x year)
z <- matrix(NA,
            nrow = simul.nimConstants$n.individuals,
            ncol = simul.nimConstants$n.years)

# ---- Etat initial ----
z[,1] <- c(rep(1, simul.nimConstants$n.individuals/2),
           rep(2, simul.nimConstants$n.individuals/2))

# ---- Etats après ----
for (t in 1:(simul.nimConstants$n.years - 1)) {
  for (i in 1:simul.nimConstants$n.individuals) {
    
    current_state <- z[i, t]
    
    # Draw next state from transition probabilities
    z[i, t + 1] <- sample(1:4, 
                          size = 1, 
                          prob = omega[current_state, , t])
  }
}
```

### isAlive
Matrice binaire : vivant ou non.
```{r}
isAlive <- ifelse(z==2, 1, 0)
dim(isAlive)
```

### sxy
```{r}
# Charger les pays
zone <- countries(c("Sweden", "Norway")) %>%
  st_as_sf()

# On prends des pts qui tombent dans notre zone
rbinomPPSingle_inside_zone <- function(
    lower, 
    upper, 
    polygon, 
    max_iter = 1000
    ){
  
  for (i in 1:max_iter) {
    # On simule un point
    pt <- rbinomPPSingle( 
      n=1,
      lowerCoords = lower,
      upperCoords = upper
      )
    # On regarde s'il tombe dans la zone
    pt_sf <- st_as_sf(
      data.frame(x=pt[1], y=pt[2]),
      coords = c("x","y"),
      crs = st_crs(polygon)
      )
    if (st_within(pt_sf, polygon, sparse = FALSE, prepared = TRUE)[1,1]) {
      return(pt)
    }
  }
  stop("Could not sample inside polygon")
}

# Meme chose
rbinomMNormSourcePPSingle_inside_zone <- function(
    lower, 
    upper, 
    polygon, 
    sourceCoords,
    max_iter = 1000) {
  
  for (i in 1:max_iter) {
    pt <- rbinomMNormSourcePPSingle(
      n=1,
      lowerCoords = lower,
      upperCoords = upper,
      sourceCoords = sourceCoords,
      normSD = 1)
    pt_sf <- st_as_sf(data.frame(x=pt[1], y=pt[2]),
                      coords = c("x","y"),
                      crs = st_crs(polygon))
    if (st_within(pt_sf, polygon, sparse = FALSE, prepared = TRUE)[1,1]) {
      return(pt)
    }
  }
  stop("Could not sample inside polygon")
}

zone_union <- st_union(zone)  # merge Sweden + Norway

sxy <- array(NA,
      dim = c(simul.nimConstants$n.individuals,
              simul.nimConstants$n.years,
              2))
# sxy dim : [i , t , coord]

sxy <- array(NA,
             dim = c(simul.nimConstants$n.individuals,
                     simul.nimConstants$n.years,
                     2))

for (j in 1:simul.nimConstants$n.individuals){
  
  # Year 1: initial activity center
  sxy[j, 1, ] <- rbinomPPSingle_inside_zone(
    lower = LowerHabCoords_fix,
    upper = UpperHabCoords_fix,
    polygon = zone_union)
  
  # Movement through years
  for (i in 2:nimConstants$n.years){
    
    sxy[j, i, ] <- rbinomMNormSourcePPSingle_inside_zone(
      lower = LowerHabCoords_fix,
      upper = UpperHabCoords_fix,
      sourceCoords = sxy[j, i-1, ],
      polygon = zone_union)
  }
}

```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
sf::sf_use_s2()

for (j in 1:nrow(isAlive)) {
  
  alive_years <- which(isAlive[j, ] == 1)
  if (length(alive_years) == 0) next
  
  first_year <- min(alive_years)
  
  # Initial AC
  sxy[j, first_year, ] <- rbinomPPSingle_inside_zone(
    lower = LowerHabCoords_fix,
    upper = UpperHabCoords_fix,
    polygon = zone_union)
  
  # Only run if there are later years
  if (first_year < ncol(isAlive)) {
    
    for (t in (first_year + 1):ncol(isAlive)) {
      
      if (!isAlive[j, t]) break
      
      sxy[j, t, ] <- rbinomMNormSourcePPSingle_inside_zone(
        lower = LowerHabCoords_fix,
        upper = UpperHabCoords_fix,
        sourceCoords = sxy[j, t - 1, ],
        polygon = zone_union)
    }
  }
}
```
## les detections : y.alive
```{r}
simul.y.alive <- array(0, 
                       dim = c(
                         simul.nimConstants$n.individuals,
                         nimConstants$n.detectors, 
                         simul.nimConstants$n.years)
                       )

trials <- rep(10, nimConstants$n.detectors)


for (i in 1:simul.nimConstants$n.individuals) {
  for (t in 1:simul.nimConstants$n.years) {
    
    # Skip si not alive
    if (isAlive[i,t] != 1) next
    
    # Distance to all detectors
    dists <- sqrt(
      (sxy[i,t,1] - nimData$detector.xy[,1])^2 +
      (sxy[i,t,2] - nimData$detector.xy[,2])^2
    )
    
    # Detection probability
    pijt <- nimInits$p0[t] * exp(-(dists^2)) / (2 * simul.nimInits$sigma^2)
    
    # Simulate detections
    simul.y.alive[i, , t] <- rbinom(
      simul.nimConstants$n.detectors,
      size = trials,
      prob = pijt
    )
  }
}

View(simul.y.alive)
table(simul.y.alive[4, , ])
```

## brouillon
```{r}
state <- sample(1:4, 
                simul.nimConstants$n.individuals, 
                replace = TRUE) # repartition initiale
pop <- matrix(0, nrow = simul.nimConstants$n.years, ncol = 4)

## population initiale
pop[1, ] <- c(
  simul.nimConstants$n.individuals/2, 
  simul.nimConstants$n.individuals/2, 
  0, 0)  # ex : tous en état 1

for (t in 1:simul.nimConstants$n.years1) {
  for (states in 1:4) {
    pop[t + 1, ] <- pop[t + 1, ] +
      rmultinom(1, pop[t, states], omega[states, , t])
  }
}
```
